actual_scope: Characteristic 5 only, six sources, unchanged unsigned dirty connector. The named sum is sigma=43, fixed before the argument. Classify the adjacent centre (21, 22) and decide whether it contains a coordinate equal to 10. The proved statement is that both legal shapes do: 60 centres with three 10s and 60 centres with two 10s. One legal step preserves every such 10. The conditional diagonal lemma does not decide whether the eight-slot chain is empty. Sigma in {3, 23, 53} is not classified.
scope_change_reason: The catalogue card asks for one new connector operation. This package keeps the alphabet fixed and answers open question 1 of PR #7044 at the single named sum sigma=43. A new operation is not the missing step. The sum-13 centre, the sum-33 chain, and the other three adjacent sums are other questions.
bottleneck_link: Side result on the recursive-interface schedule. It does not change a supplier, a consumer, or kappa. A coordinate 10 on this adjacent centre is the immovable freeze on a diagonal the sum-33 walk does not see. The count equation at prefix length 21 is what PR #7044 left blocked.
stop_rule: Stop after the adjacent pair (21, 22) is classified and the coordinate-10 question is answered under written hypotheses. Do not classify sigma in {3, 23, 53} and do not decide the eight-slot chain.
evidence: Proof: the nonnegative solutions of the centre equations at prefix total 21 are (r_w, n0, n3, n5)=(0, 0, 2, 3) and (2, 0, 3, 2). Both have n5 >= 2, so the centre sum has two or three coordinates equal to 10. The only immovable value in {0,1,5,6,10} is 10. The one-step case split gives 360 stationary images and 180 moving images, and every legal image keeps those coordinates. If all eight sum-43 slots are legal, the same 10s survive to q_14, which can hold a 5; emptiness of that chain is not claimed. Exhaustive census: 46656 prefix tuples, 120 legal centres, 300 coordinates equal to 10, all 120 realizable by floor words, 540 legal one-step images. Two witness words, one per shape. No SAT run. No kappa change. Selected kappa remains 363005817/100000000000.
